title: What's New: Processing of Presentment Currencies in Shopify (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Background: Markets, currencies, and the problem
New currency handling setting in Shopify shop card
Synchronizing orders and viewing store currency
Creating sales documents in presentment currency
Editing documents and switching between currency modes

features.name: Presentment currency support in Shopify order processing
features.description: Allows sales documents to be created in the presentment currency (the currency shown to the customer at checkout) instead of only the store currency. Previously, Business Central only imported both currencies but created sales documents in the store currency.
caveats: Presentment currency field is not editable once populated
Default behavior remains shop currency to avoid sudden changes on upgrade
Users can change between shop currency and presentment currency modes and recreate documents

features.name: Currency handling field on Shopify shop card
features.description: New field in Shopify shop card order processing section with two options: shop currency (default) or presentment currency. Allows users to control how orders are created in Business Central.
caveats: Requires clicking 'show more' to see the field
Default is shop currency for backward compatibility

features.name: Processed currency field in orders
features.description: New field populated after document processing that shows which currency was used to create the sales document, either store currency or presentment currency.
caveats: Only populated after processing the order

features.name: Price synchronization for catalogs linked to markets
features.description: Previous release capability to synchronize prices for catalogs associated with different markets (regions), allowing different tax, price, and localization rules per market.
